context: A boss and his manager read social-issue headlines
purpose: Teach: 国王/戦士/法曹/国庫/連帯/募金/カトリック/中毒

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おはよう、健司。今朝の新聞、一面に北欧の国王の写真が大きく載ってたな。
lines.en: Morning, Kenji. The front page had a big photo of the Northern European king today.
lines.style: Boss greets casually, coffee in hand, scanning the front page with mild curiosity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ああ、見ました。妙に若々しい王様ですよね。私はむしろ隣の法曹改革の記事の方が気になりましたが。
lines.en: Yeah, I saw. He looks oddly youthful, doesn't he. Honestly the legal-profession reform article next to it caught my eye more.
lines.style: Manager replies with a light chuckle, then steers toward what actually interests him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ほう、君らしいな。あれ、結局は国庫の負担をどう減らすかって話だろう？うちには関係なさそうだが。
lines.en: Heh, that's just like you. In the end it's about cutting the treasury burden, isn't it? Doesn't seem to affect us much.
lines.style: Boss teases lightly, then shrugs with a businessman's detached pragmatism.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうとも言えませんよ。三面のカトリック団体の街頭募金、あれ、難民支援って書いてました。社会の連帯って、結局回り回ってきますから。
lines.en: I wouldn't say that. The Catholic group's street fundraising on page three — it's for refugees. Social solidarity comes back around eventually.
lines.style: Manager pushes back gently but firmly, voice warming as he makes his point.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふむ。お前、朝から熱いな。
lines.en: Hmm. You're awfully fired up this morning.
lines.style: Boss smirks, half-impressed and half-amused at his manager's morning passion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: すみません、つい。あと退役した戦士たちのアルコール中毒の記事も読んで、ちょっと考えさせられて。
lines.en: Sorry, got carried away. I also read the piece on retired soldiers' alcohol addiction and it stuck with me.
lines.style: Manager apologizes sheepishly, lowering his voice as the topic darkens.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、あれは重いな。うちの叔父も自衛隊上がりで、似たような時期があった。
lines.en: Ah, that one's heavy. My uncle was ex-SDF, and he went through something similar.
lines.style: Boss's tone drops, suddenly personal, eyes drifting from the paper.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Manager responds softly, genuinely caught off guard by the personal revelation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: まあ、昔の話だ。さて、その熱意で午後までに記事の要約頼むぞ。期待してるからな。
lines.en: Well, old story. Anyway, channel that passion and get me a summary of those articles by this afternoon. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Boss recovers with a wry smile, pivoting back to work with affectionate gruffness.
